nom: Mario Badescu Hydrogel Under Eye Patches

avis.texte: I used these patches in the morning after doing my skincare and immediately felt a cooling sensation. After less than a minute, I felt like they were burning and I took them off. I had angry red skin where the patches had been. Over the next two days, one of my under eyes became swollen and purple with a huge bump and the other eye is completely bloodshot. Not recommended for sensitive skin.
I wake up looking so tired all the time. These do help and help with improvement in puffiness but i hate how they slide down the face the first 5-10 min.
They do slide down. I had to adjust them few a times but they do work.
Best eye patches I have ever tried!My skin feels so amazing after using them and they feel so great while there on. I'm getting ready to order the facial mask by Mario here at Ulta!

I use these in the morning when heading out and they work great. They're a little heavy at first but I think because they're better quality than ones I've used before and after a couple minutes they feel more secure and so good!
While the gel works, the patches are heavy and will slide down your face. I had to lie down while using them.
I love using this in the morning when im feeling extra tired!
